ItemID: 1; Title: 1/2 Push Connect Valve,CEKER 1/2 inch OD Quick Connect Tube Fittings Pneumatic Valve Push Fittings Union Straight Air Flow Control Valve 1Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a pneumatic project needing this tubing size.
ItemID: 2; Title: Duct Tape Heavy Duty Waterproof Bulk of 5, 11 Mils Black Duct Tape 2 inches x 33 Yards, Max Strength No Residue Industrial Tape, Tear by Hand for DIY Repairs, Industrial, All-Weather Multipurpose Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for my frequent workshop repairs, though five rolls would probably last me a while.
ItemID: 3; Title: 3M Double Sided Mounting Tape, 3M5952 Heavy Duty VHB Foam Adhesive 1/2"x15.4 FT for Indoor Outdoor, LED Strip Lights, Automotive Trim & Home Office Décor, Waterproof & Industrial Grade,1/2” x 15.4 FT; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Strong mounting tape fits the fastening and adhesive work I already do, especially when screws are impractical.
ItemID: 4; Title: Lichamp Step Drill Bit Set for Metal Sheet Heavy Duty, 5-Piece HSS Step Up Down Drill Bits Stepper Unibit for Steel Hole, 50 Sizes from 1/8 to 1-3/8 inches, B105RD; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: These would complement my existing drill bits for enlarging sheet-metal holes when fitting rivets and rivet nuts.
ItemID: 5; Title: TechSegment 1/2" Valve PVC Ball Valve ASTM SOCKET T-Handle Water Shut-Off Schedule 40X Solvent Connections White & Red; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current PVC plumbing job requiring a solvent-connected valve.
ItemID: 6; Title: Joywayus Brass Shut Off Ball Valve 1/2" Barb x Barb 2-Way Hose Ball Valve Fitting; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need a specific hose project and matching dimensions before choosing this fitting.
ItemID: 7; Title: ELOOGAA 3Pcs Solderless Breadboard 830 Point Solderless Prototype PCB Board Kit for Arduino Proto Shield Distribution Connecting Blocks; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent work is mainly mechanical fastening and fabrication, with no immediate circuit-prototyping need.
ItemID: 8; Title: 3D Printer Resin, JAYO 1KG 3D Resin for 4K 8K LCD/DLP/SLA 3D Printers, 405nm Standard Photopolymer Fast Curing Resin, High Precision, Low Shrinkage, Clear Blue 1000g; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My epoxy resin work does not give me a use for printer resin, and I have no established need for a resin printer consumable.
ItemID: 9; Title: Wintact Decibel Meter 30 to 130dBA, Digital Sound Noise Level Reader Tester Portable with Calibration for Classroom Home, School, Outdoor, Ambient; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use measurement tools, but sound-level testing is not a task I currently need to tackle.
ItemID: 10; Title: Deck Screws 1-1/4 inch, TOPMALLEX #8 Exterior Wood Screws 320 PCS, with Star Drive, Tan Coated for Outdoor Use, No Stripping, Anti-Corrosion, Coarse Threads, T-25 Drive Bit Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my interest in practical fasteners, but I would wait for an outdoor wood project that needs this exact screw length.
